next_legal_transport_proposal.status: Proposed only; not executed; research balance may not fund another native run
next_legal_transport_proposal.component: Transport aged hazard points with legal ego-motion rotation and translation while preserving occluded hazards.
next_legal_transport_proposal.legal_inputs: Existing road-image optical-flow affine transform when accepted; otherwise consider fixed current HUD yaw/speed and a body-frame SE(2) motion approximation. Use measured GT only for diagnostic errors, never as policy motion input.
next_legal_transport_proposal.transform: p_next = R(-delta_yaw) (p_old - estimated_body_displacement); verify yaw sign, frame convention, sampling lag and pixel scaling on stored TRAIN observations. Norm speed alone does not reveal lateral velocity; forward-only translation is an approximation.
next_legal_transport_proposal.preserve_occlusion: Transport retained points, retain unchanged radius/age limit/dedup and direct detection. Missing current detection during occlusion must not delete a retained point. Direct-only333 probe is not a proposed replacement tracker.
next_legal_transport_proposal.isolation: Stored-pixel current tracker vs one transport-component change, identical detections/retention/route/controller constants. Include actual occlusion examples with saved GT where available; current N2 late observations alone do not validate occlusion preservation.
next_legal_transport_proposal.offline_gate: First reproduce original stored actor outputs and frame transforms; measure stale-point world/body error, duplicate persistence, real occluded-obstacle retention and downstream routing changes without any fit or threshold search. Stop mismatches. No automatic horizon extension or native budget expansion.
next_legal_transport_proposal.native_gate: Only after offline evidence, separately preregister any native comparison and its budget; preserve final reserve84000. No such run under333.
